high_level_description: The image depicts a person holding a flag during what appears to be an event, possibly an opening or closing ceremony of the Olympics. The individual is dressed in a brown leather jacket and light-colored pants, suggesting a casual yet stylish outfit. They are holding a flag that prominently features the Olympic rings in blue, yellow, black, green, and red, which are the colors of the Olympic flag. The flag also has additional elements, including a white background with a design that includes the colors of the Italian flag (green, white, and red) at the top right corner.
